decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a multi-model design line close to the core offer and fits the firm's announced design-led direction, so the investment and commitment to it argue for keeping it even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The shower channel for seamless coverings is presented on its own page, central to the barrier-free bathroom strategy, and close to the core offer, so visible commitment favours persisting with it.
The pump-assisted line took more development investment and supports barrier-free solutions, so management would treat any weak early sales as a temporary ramp-up rather than drop it.
The tileable floor drain is a core-adjacent product presented prominently on its own page, which signals public commitment and low cost to keep it on the market.
The stainless steel design grate embodies the firm's design-and-engineering positioning and has its own page, so management would persist with it.
